frequency_question: What proportion of major expiring transboundary water treaties are successfully renegotiated and signed within 30 months of expiration?
membership_rule: Bilateral or multilateral treaties governing shared river basins that reached a formal expiration or renewal milestone, excluding non-binding memorandums of understanding.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty Modernization talks
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II milestones
Senegal River Basin Development Organization (OMVS) protocol renewals
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty modification notices

coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 7 in total for this specific class of high-friction renewals
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical protocol adjustments lacking high-level political friction.
skeleton: Global transboundary water treaty renewals over a 30-year sample divided by total major expiring frameworks in the same interval.
multiplier: 4 hits / 7 observed total major friction-point renewals = 0.57
validity_reason: Covers the entire duration until the resolution date of the target question.
